guidelines.text: Standard Grid to be inputted centally
Only Base Commission Needs to be updated in the Following sheet, Additionally we have created GWP based Rule Incremental COA
Payout % for CV on Net Premium
Payout % for Pvt Car- SATP on Net Premium; Package and SAOD on OD premium
Payout% for TW to be applied on New  (1+5 premium) + Old(1+1 premium)
LTTP not be considered for premium slab as well as payout %
RTO Cluster identification- for all policies_RTO mapped on policy; for Brand New- If RTO is not available; producer tagged to branch and RTO of that branch to be used
Producers not on covered in pt 6 a/b/c shall by default fall under standard grid

Cancellation/Endorsement: For the purpose of Business Slab calculation Net premium will be considered post effect to cancellation/endorsement premium; Payout% which will be reversed for cancellation and paid for endorsement will be based on the % which is applicable in the month of cancellation/endorsement for interim period till system is live

notes: Package / SAOD % applies on OD premium; SATP % applies on Net premium.
Visible 'Pvtcar' sheet holds the base commission; an additional GWP-slab incremental rule (portfolio level) is out of scope for a single-policy rate.
